description: Every ConnectSecure API operation, plus a local store that answers vulnerability x asset x client questions across your whole client base in one command.

auth_env_var_specs.name: CONNECTSECURE_ACCESS_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Pre-minted JWT from /w/authorize. Optional: set this OR CONNECTSECURE_TENANT + CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_ID + CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_SECRET and the CLI mints and caches it.

auth_env_var_specs.name: CONNECTSECURE_TENANT
auth_env_var_specs.description: Tenant name you type on the ConnectSecure portal login screen.

auth_env_var_specs.name: CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: API client ID from Settings > Users > (user) > API Key.

auth_env_var_specs.name: CONNECTSECURE_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: API client secret from Settings > Users > (user) > API Key.

env_var.name: CONNECTSECURE_USER_ID
env_var.description: user_id from /w/authorize. Only needed with a pre-minted CONNECTSECURE_ACCESS_TOKEN; minting fills it automatically.

novel_features.name: Cross-client exposure matrix
novel_features.description: Reads the synced local store (run sync first): rank open vulnerabilities across all clients at asset level, one row per problem x asset x client, top 50 by default (--limit 0 for all), filtered by EPSS, severity, KEV or first-seen window.

novel_features.name: Client portfolio
novel_features.description: Reads the synced local store (run sync first): one row per client with asset count, critical and high findings, max EPSS, KEV count, risk score, stale assets and active suppressions.

novel_features.name: Scan blind spots
novel_features.description: Reads the synced local store (run sync first): list assets whose scan data cannot be trusted (stale discovery, unauthenticated scan, silent agent), sorted by client with reason codes; the unauthenticated check is a keyword heuristic unless you pass --auth-ok.

novel_features.name: QBR risk pack
novel_features.description: Live API call: one client's QBR numbers in one call, with risk score, latest company stats, open findings by age, top fixes and remediation speed; compliance pass/fail is added only when --compliance-type, --compliance-platform and --compliance-section are all set.

novel_features.name: Suppression audit
novel_features.description: Reads the synced local store (run sync first): flag suppressions that expired but are still active, expire soon, never expire, or were unapproved or self-approved, with the suppressed issue's current EPSS.

novel_features.name: CVE impact
novel_features.description: Live API call: for one CVE, show affected clients with asset counts, affected software, available fixes and CVSS/EPSS, and report any assets the API could not attribute to a client.

novel_features.name: AD hygiene
novel_features.description: Reads the synced local store (run sync first): per client, risky Active Directory accounts (password never expires, not required, no MFA, stale logon), weak password policies and Azure secure score.
